mechanism: Burke ratio = (net profit or mean return) / sqrt((1/N)·Σ MaxD_i²) where MaxD are the T largest absolute peak-to-trough equity drawdowns (default T=N/20 via MaxNDrawdowns pairwise scan). Non-parametric alternative to Sharpe that senses path risk from the worst drawdown cluster rather than return stdev.
data_needed: Equity curve array (or SPX-based simulated equity); count of highest drawdowns T; optional mean-return series.

mechanism: Omega = mean(returns) / LPM^{1/2} with degree-2 lower partial moment vs threshold (article uses 0): LPM_n = mean(max(thresh−r_t,0)^n). Focuses risk only on returns below the MAR/threshold—downside volatility sensor without normality. Companion UPR = HPM^{1/2}/LPM^{1/2} contrasts upside vs downside partial moments.

mechanism: Optimize EA on IS half of original + ≥100 permuted custom symbols; record OOS profit on each; p-value = fraction of permuted OOS profits ≥ original OOS profit. data_needed: Base symbol date range; ≥100 permutations; IS/OOS split; optimized params; profit metric.
